name: Air
source: Pathfinder Rage of Elements, Air adjustment (pg. 67), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=16
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Rage of Elements is ORC licensed material.
rules: Adds the air trait and Sussuran (if it has languages); fly Speed 25 feet at 8th level or higher.
optional: Optional: below 8th level, you can give it the fly Speed 25 feet if it doesn't have ranged attacks or you remove them; use discretion. If it can cast spells, you can replace spells with air spells of the same rank, such as: cantrip gale blast, 1st gust of wind, 2nd cleanse air, 3rd wall of wind, 4th fly, 5th pressure zone, 6th phantom orchestra, 7th fly, 8th whirlwind, 9th wrathful storm.
